caption: The image shows a round plate with a detailed black-and-white illustration in its center and ornamental decoration along the rim. The central illustration depicts an urban scene with several multi-story buildings, one of which has many identical windows visible on its façade. A street runs diagonally through the scene, bordered by trees and leading towards the background, where masts of ships are visible, suggesting proximity to a harbor or dock. Smaller figures, possibly people, are dispersed along the street, along with some carts or carriages. In the foreground, there are clusters of flowering plants and foliage, including large leafy trees whose branches arc over the scene and partially frame it. The plate’s rim is decorated with numerous floral and leaf motifs, forming a dense, decorative border. The overall coloration appears as varying shades of gray, indicating a monochromatic or grayscale image.
